title: In onPersistentGroupsChanged of WifiP2pServiceImpl.java, there is a possible permission bypass due to… (CVE-2026-58870)
description: CVE-2026-58870 is a vulnerability in the onPersistentGroupsChanged method of WifiP2pServiceImpl.java where a missing permission check allows a possible permission bypass. This flaw could enable local information disclosure without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
